review_scope: Phase 1 base-record and mechanical-metadata evidence only. This review made no visual, audible, caller, provenance, suitability, disposition, or later-phase assessment.

checks.detail: CI=true python3 measure/tracks/apk_existing_asset_candidate_audit_20260712/phase1-contract-test.py exited 0 and reported the exact frozen 428-path/227-group reconciliation. Its required eleven negative fixtures executed.

The 12 base-record and 12 mechanical-metadata artifact SHA-256 values directly recomputed from the current files match the values bound by their respective aggregate receipts and reconciliation records.

Static review confirms the contract enforces exact frozen batch membership, 428 paths, 227 atomic hash groups, five root counts, per-batch and aggregate resource ceilings, ordered producer input allowlists, receipt output hashes, and absence of later-phase artifacts.
The invalidated preliminary mechanical attempt is explicitly non-consumable and reports zero accepted producer outputs; the current mechanical receipt is a distinct retry artifact.

No direct all-428 Git-blob decode/parse rerun was performed in this v1 review after the first Medium findings, at root instruction. The producer's claimed 8 decode failures and 2 empty paths were therefore not independently rederived here, and no claim is made about other candidate bytes.

medium.title: Zero-mislabeled result is unsupported by the mechanical producer
medium.affected_paths: All 428 frozen canonical candidate paths, emitted across mechanical-metadata.json in AF-01 through AF-12.
medium.evidence: generate_phase1_mechanical_metadata.py assigns mislabeled: false in image_metadata, media_metadata, and data_metadata, including their failure wrappers, without any magic-byte, container, or declared-label comparison. The reported zero-mislabeled result thus cannot establish the required per-path label-consistency fact.
medium.remediation: Add deterministic signature/container validation for PNG, JPG, SVG, MP3, WebM, JSON, and UTF-8 text; emit the derived mislabeled flag for every record; add a negative fixture for a label/signature disagreement; regenerate all 12 metadata outputs and receipts.

medium.title: Parsed SVG records omit required mechanical dimensions
medium.evidence: Each record has parse_status passed but width and height are null. The generator XML-parses the blob and then unconditionally emits null dimensions instead of deriving width/height or viewBox geometry.
medium.remediation: Derive and record SVG width, height, and/or normalized viewBox dimensions with an explicit no-intrinsic-dimension state only when source attributes genuinely lack such information; strengthen the contract and fixture coverage; regenerate affected metadata and receipts.

medium.title: Mechanical producer model provenance is not exact
medium.evidence: Both generator and receipt declare the model as Terra, not the exact gpt-5.6-terra identifier required for a truthful isolated producer receipt. The current contract only checks that declared_model is non-empty, so it does not detect this provenance defect.
medium.remediation: Correct the declared model to the exact execution model, require that exact value in the contract, and regenerate the mechanical receipt after the metadata remediation.

decision.rule: Pass requires zero Critical, High, and Medium findings.
decision.next_action: Remediate all three Medium findings, rerun the focused contract and full independent all-428 Git-blob mechanical verification in a fresh Phase 1 v2 review. This receipt does not accept Phase 1, close T8, authorize caller/provenance/inspection/suitability work, or publish a candidate manifest.
